papers.title: Towards a General Intelligence and Interface for Wearable Health Data
papers.what: Foundation model pretrained on 1T+ minutes of wearable signals from 5M participants, evaluated on 35 health tasks with LLM-agent AutoML for downstream heads.

papers.title: Chronicle: A Multimodal Foundation Model for Joint Language and Time Series Understanding
papers.what: 324M-param transformer trained from scratch on text and time series in one architecture; beats unimodal FMs in both domains.

papers.title: Superposition Is Not Necessary: Mechanistic Interpretability of Transformer Representations for TS Forecasting
papers.what: SAE probing of PatchTST shows no superposition on forecasting benchmarks, explaining why linear models stay competitive.

papers.title: RL for LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems through Orchestration Traces
papers.what: Formalizes multi-agent RL via temporal interaction graphs; identifies five orchestration sub-decisions and a gap in stopping-decision training.
